title: (3) Discord | "Suggestion: Increasing the Word Limit for Notes and Story Records" | 프론티아

msgs.txt:
Hello! I would like to kindly suggest increasing the word limit for notes and story records beyond the current 1,250-word limit.
As a story progresses and roleplay sessions become longer, the amount of information that needs to be preserved naturally grows over time. Important details about characters, relationships, past events, and ongoing storylines gradually accumulate, making the current limit increasingly insufficient for maintaining continuity and preserving the full depth of the experience.
I understand that increasing the word limit may come with additional costs or technical challenges for the company and the platform. However, having such a limited space to record important information has become a significant obstacle to my enjoyment of the experience. It can be genuinely discouraging to have to constantly shorten, remove, or sacrifice details that are meaningful to the story simply because there is not enough room to preserve them. Over time, this can even make me feel like giving up on a story that I have invested so much time and emotion into.
If possible, I would sincerely appreciate it if the team could consider raising the limit to at least 3,000 words, or perhaps even higher if the system can reasonably support it. Even a moderate increase would make a meaningful difference for users who enjoy long-running stories and immersive roleplay.
I believe that allowing users to preserve more of their story's history and important details would greatly improve the overall experience, making it easier to continue long-term stories without losing the elements that make them special.
Thank you so much for taking the time to read my suggestion and for all the effort you put into improving the platform. I truly appreciate your work, and I hope this feedback can be considered for a future update
My apologies for forgetting to mention, I meant from a player's perspective I'm not a developer; I'm just a player who wanted to highlight issues that many other players are experiencing as well

I couldn’t agree more. It’s truly disheartening that all my efforts went to waste in an instant—the moment the recording limit was reached, the bot started saying bizarre things and lost its memory. I’ve invested a significant amount of money into playing through this story and was genuinely looking forward to seeing what happens next, but the further I go, the more burnt out I feel instead (수정됨)

We completely understand how important memory is, especially for players who have invested so much time and emotion into their stories.  Please know that improving player memory is one of the key areas the Frontia team is actively reviewing with high priority.  We kindly ask for a little more patience, and we'll be sure to share updates with everyone as soon as we have improvements to announce!  Thank you again for your continued support, patience, and love for Frontia. It truly means a lot to our team!
